description: This file defines the Meeting class for SuiteCRM, extending SugarBean, including properties, methods for access control, saving, notifications, relationship management, and external API integration specific to meetings.

classes.name: Meeting
classes.description: Represents a meeting entity in SuiteCRM, with properties for meeting details, relationships, and methods for managing meetings, notifications, external API integration, and access control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Meeting object, sets up custom fields, and loads duration intervals if available.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Controls access permissions for editing, saving, deleting meetings, especially for recurring meetings sourced outside SugarCRM.

methods.name: hasIntegratedMeeting
methods.description: Stub method indicating whether the meeting has external integration; returns false.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the meeting, calculates end date/time, handles external API scheduling, notifications, and reminders.

methods.name: removeUnInvitedFromReminders
methods.description: Removes invitees not present in the current contacts, users, or leads arrays from reminders.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes the meeting and corrects recurrences, updates vCal cache.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the meeting's name as summary text.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds SQL query for exporting meeting data, optionally including contact info.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields like assigned user name, contact name, and related info.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list view, including status, date formatting, and contact info.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Generates email notification content with meeting details and accept URLs.

methods.name: create_notification_email
methods.description: Creates email with iCal attachment for meeting notification.

methods.name: send_assignment_notifications
methods.description: Removes iCal attachment after email sent.

methods.name: get_meeting_users
methods.description: Retrieves users linked to the meeting with their acceptance status.

methods.name: get_invite_meetings
methods.description: Retrieves meetings a user is invited to with pending acceptance.

methods.name: set_accept_status
methods.description: Sets acceptance status for a user, contact, or lead related to the meeting.

methods.name: get_notification_recipients
methods.description: Returns list of users, contacts, and leads to notify about the meeting.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates support for ACL interface.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Determines ACL permissions for list view display of parent and contact info.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Saves relationship links, excluding certain fields during import or workflow.

methods.name: afterImportSave
methods.description: Links the parent contact or lead after import.

methods.name: getDefaultStatus
methods.description: Returns default status for new meetings based on field definitions or language strings.
